    name,
    "slug": slug.current,
    demo,
    active,
    price,
    regularPrice,
    description,
    capacity,
    show,
    releasedQuantity,
    earlyBirdCutoff,
    requiresDaySelection,
    requiresAttendeeNames,

    capacityPool,
    headcountPerUnit,
    excludedDays
  }
